hero.subtitle: YOUR PRIVATE REFUGE IN JUQUEHY
hero.title: Vila Dolores
hero.headline_2: comfort of home, practicality of a loft
hero.quote: "In the 80s, our grandmother Dolores brought us to Juquehy for the first time. Back then, the beach was a well-kept secret, with few houses and residents. Decades later, we transformed that memory into a space that celebrates warmth and family time, making those who stay here feel at home, even when away from home."

about.title: HOUSE APARTMENTS
about.desc_1: Vila Dolores is an exclusive collection of four house apartments that combine the comfort and privacy of a home with the practicality and functionality of a modern loft.
about.desc_2: Each unit has been carefully designed to offer spacious, fully equipped, and welcoming environments that balance design and coziness, ideal for those seeking days of rest and fun with family or friends.
about.desc_3: Check "Our Villas" to find the ideal configuration for you!
about.beach_desc_1: With over 3 km in length, Juquehy features a wide strip of fine white sand, transparent blue waters, and a sunset that invites you to stay on the beach.
about.beach_desc_2: From surfing to the tranquility of a delightful sea bath, the beach also attracts athletes who enjoy running, playing ball, frescobol, and cycling.
about.beach_desc_3: A family-friendly environment that will enchant you!

casa_1.name: Casa 1
casa_1.short_desc: Cozy and practical — perfect for smaller families.
casa_1.full_desc: Casa 1, located on the ground floor, offers full convenience for those who want to arrive from the beach, settle in easily, and enjoy the house without climbing stairs. At 70 m², it features an integrated kitchen and living area in a spacious environment, plus two bedrooms and bathrooms that ensure practicality and comfort for the whole family. The small private backyard rounds out the space with a pleasant breath of fresh air.

list.room: 1 bedroom with 2 single beds and integrated bathroom
list.living: Open concept dining and living room, double sofa bed and connected TV
list.kitchen: Kitchen equipped with cooktop, refrigerator, microwave and utensils for 6 guests

casa_1.footer: Perfect for those who want to arrive, settle in properly and enjoy the sea without worries.

casa_2.name: Casa 2
casa_2.short_desc: Ample space with a private gourmet patio — to enjoy after the beach.
casa_2.full_desc: Casa 2, also located on the ground floor, has as its great differentiator a spacious private patio with a living area, BBQ grill, and exclusive outdoor shower. In addition to the 70 m² of interior space, the house gains this outdoor living area, perfect for gathering the family, preparing a barbecue, relaxing, and enjoying great moments together. A delightful combination of the comfort and practicality of the interior spaces with the pleasure of a unique outdoor area.

list.room: 1 bedroom with double bed + single bed and integrated bathroom

list.kitchen: Kitchen equipped with cooktop, refrigerator, microwave and utensils for 7 guests
list.patio: Private gourmet patio with BBQ grill

casa_2.footer: The perfect environment for barbecues, laughter and good times outdoors.

casa_3.name: Casa 3
casa_3.short_desc: More space across 2 floors, enhanced comfort, and a private gourmet solarium.
casa_3.full_desc: Casa 3 offers the charm and spaciousness of a duplex residence. On the lower floor, the integrated living, dining, and kitchen areas share the space with two spacious bedrooms, across more than 70 m² of interior space. On the upper floor, the mezzanine creates a second living area and provides access to one of the house's great differentiators: the private 20 m² solarium, with an exclusive BBQ grill and outdoor shower. A special space to relax, gather the family, and enjoy great moments outdoors, day or night.

list.mezzanine: Mezzanine with connected TV and double sofa bed
list.kitchen: Kitchen equipped with cooktop, refrigerator, microwave and utensils for 8 guests

casa_3.footer: The ideal space for those who want comfort and the freedom to enjoy day and night on their own rooftop.

casa_4.name: Casa 4
casa_4.short_desc: The same structure and charm as Casa 3, featuring a private gourmet solarium.
casa_4.full_desc: Casa 4 mirrors the beautiful duplex architecture of Casa 3, with spacious environments spread across two floors. On the lower floor, there's more than 70 m² with an integrated living, dining, and kitchen area, plus two comfortable bedrooms and two bathrooms. On the upper floor, the mezzanine expands the living space and connects to the private 20 m² solarium, creating a true rooftop to enjoy outdoors. A perfect house for families or groups of friends who value comfort, spaciousness, and an exclusive space to enjoy their stay.
